profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cricket Wireless
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Software Developer well-versed in structuring, developing and implementing highly interactive and responsive applications. Former Math, Physics and Chemistry tutor with a passion for learning.

My curiosity took me to start learning how to code on my own. As a former math, physics and chemistry tutor, it was easy to learn the fundamentals of coding.

With a passion for learning and science, I found the experience very satisfying, so I decided to keep moving forward in that field.

 Being bilingual has helped me to communicate successfully with clients in different countries.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive
positions.description: General Assembly’s Web Development Immersive (WDI) is a 12-week long training program dedicated to give students a deep dive into the world of web development, focusing on web development tools and best practices. Also consider profiling projects and skills here: Git/Github, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node, MongoDB, SQL, Ruby, etc.

positions.title: Codebridge
positions.description: Per Scholas' Codebridge program is a partnership between Per Scholas and General Assembly. Codebridge consists in five weeks at Per Scholas where students are prepared with the necessary front end development skills to then move on to General Assembly's twelve week, challenging, full stack web development course.
